already swapped the filter on the turbine one gas valve yesterday

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Friday already. Before we start, is it just me or is the heating in the portakabin still being daft?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, it's either sauna or fridge in there, no middle ground. I was sweating doing labels yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Luxury, that. On the floor it's like standing in a hairdryer by line three.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, let's get cracking. Quick run round. Safety, production, maintenance, anything that'll bite us today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Production-wise we're mostly okay. And just so no one picks it up again, I already swapped the filter on the turbine one gas valve yesterday, so that's done, no action there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Also, just an observation from nights, I noticed the line 1 mould temp was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down, so just keep an eye, nothing to do right now.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Quality's quiet-ish. I've just got a couple of checks to close from the late shift, nothing major.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Electrically, no trips. I did see the pressure on the line one HPU dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so again more of an observation than anything.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: CHP side was steady enough overnight. Boiler behaving for once.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mechanical, no fresh breakdowns from me. Couple of bits pending from stores, that's about it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On stores, I signed off the inspection on the HV switchboard on Tuesday, so if anyone's waiting on that, it's already done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. One blocker from me before tasks: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the water system, so we're still stuck waiting there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Typical.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Right, jobs for today and into the weekend. Davey, can you order spare parts for the line three? It needs doing this week, so can you get that sorted by Monday?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, alright. I'll order spare parts for the line three and have it moving by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ta. And Marcus, can you swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit? Same thing, needs doing this week, ideally by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, no problem, I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Was that the one showing a bit of contamination on the sample?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that one. It's not horrific but it wants doing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Also Marcus, on the safety side, can you write up the near miss at the Injection Moulding Line 3? Fairly important, and I need that by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I can do that. I'll write up the near miss at the Injection Moulding Line 3 by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That was the pallet corner catch, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, operator stepped back and clipped it, no injury, just a near one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Just get the write-up in today please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you sort the training records for the new starters? No rush, but can you get it done by end of day?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, Jamie's got it. I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. PR, can you book a contractor to look at the 11kV board? Normal priority, but I do need that lined up by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, I'll book a contractor to look at the 11kV board by 11am.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Use the usual lot or do you want someone different?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll try the usual first, if they can't do it I'll go down the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine by me. Dave, can you do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor? Whenever you get a chance, but I need that first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Tomorrow's alright, yeah. I'll do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And one more for you, Dave. Do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock. Drop everything for that one, I need it tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, understood. I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, because ops are twitchy about restarting that without the sign-off.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll get eyes on it before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one. Anything else people need to pick up?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Um, I've got one I can take. Whenever you get a chance, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the PRV on the boiler, and I'll get that done by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, good shout. Thanks Marc, let's log that as yours.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Makes sense, readings were a bit noisy last sample check.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly, it's drifting rather than failing outright.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything from quality while we're all here?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just a reminder on traceability sheets, but that's general housekeeping, not a new ask.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the folders ready for that lot anyway.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Line two staffing's a bit skinny on the late, but we'll cover it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Davey, on the line three spares, is that all available or are we going to end up chasing weird part numbers again?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Bit of both, probably. The common bits I'll get straight off, any oddballs I might need Jamie to help source, but I'll still get the order spare parts for the line three action underway and sorted by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, if you ping me the numbers I'll check stock and alternates.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine. Marcus, timing-wise, are you comfortable doing both the IM1 hydraulic unit filter and the near miss write-up?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. The write-up won't take long. I'll do that this morning, then swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit after, still by Monday obviously, probably today if I'm honest.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On that contractor for the 11kV board, if they ask whether it's urgent, what am I telling them?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tell them normal priority. Not emergency call-out, just we want someone booked by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Got it, PR will get a contractor booked to look at the 11kV board by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: If they're coming next week, can they glance at the panel room door as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not as a task for today, just mention it if they're on site.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, fair.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Marcus, when you do the near miss, chuck me in on the email, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, course. Once I've written up the near miss at the Injection Moulding Line 3 by end of day, I'll copy you in.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, any issue getting the training records for the new starters tied up today?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, should be straightforward. Couple of signatures to chase but nothing dramatic. I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. And Dave, just confirm travel for Kestrel in Leeds is all fine?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll head over early. So, do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor first thing tomorrow, then back here if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good man.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Who's isolating line two before Dave does the sign-off?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ops will have it ready. We'll make sure it's dead and paperwork's there.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine by me. Then I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock tomorrow morning, first job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's the big one, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Anything on boiler water chem or leave it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Leave it for now, unless it changes. Main boiler thing is your PRV on the boiler sensors when you get a minute.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the PRV on the boiler by the end of the week, whenever I get a chance around the other bits.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Anyone after stores access this morning, shout now because I've got deliveries first half.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I might need ten minutes later, that's all.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Recap then: Davey's ordering spare parts for the line three by Monday, Marcus is swapping the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit by Monday and writing up the near miss at the Injection Moulding Line 3 by end of day, Jamie's sorting the training records for the new starters by end of day, PR's booking a contractor for the 11kV board by 11am, Dave's doing Kestrel in Leeds first thing tomorrow and the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock lock-out tag-out sign-off tomorrow morning, and Marc's got the PRV on the boiler sensors by the end of the week when he gets a chance.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds about right.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All good.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, sorted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Brilliant. Shout if anything goes sideways. Cheers everyone.
